        ### Question
        Drug of choice for gonococcal as well as non gonococcal urethritis is

        ### Options
        opa. Clindamycin
opb. Cefepime
opc. Metronidazole
opd. Azithromycin

### Reasoning Chains per Option:
CHAIN: "Azithromycin" -> "effective against Chlamydia trachomatis" -> "treats non-gonococcal urethritis" -> "also effective against Neisseria gonorrhoeae" -> "treats gonococcal urethritis" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Cefepime" -> "broad-spectrum antibiotic" -> "not first-line for Chlamydia trachomatis" -> "less effective for non-gonococcal urethritis" -> "effective against Neisseria gonorrhoeae" -> "not optimal for dual treatment of gonococcal and non-gonococcal urethritis" -> 60%

response.enhanced_information: Azithromycin is the preferred treatment for both gonococcal and non-gonococcal urethritis due to its effectiveness against both Neisseria gonorrhoeae and Chlamydia trachomatis. Cefepime, while effective against Neisseria gonorrhoeae, is not optimal due to its ineffectiveness against Chlamydia trachomatis. Metronidazole and Clindamycin are not suitable as they do not target the pathogens responsible for these infections. The choice of azithromycin is supported by its dual efficacy, making it an effective single treatment option for both conditions.
